strings.text: Only the wind and the trees live here now.
strings.translation: Тут тепер живуть тільки вітер і дерева.

strings.text: They left for three days. They took only their papers.
strings.translation: Виїжджали на три дні. Узяли тільки документи.

strings.text: The wheel was meant to start turning on the first of May.
The cabins still sway. Only from the wind.
